Currently on OpenAI (mix of gpt-4o for chat + embeddings). Complaints: cost volatility at scale, opaque throughput limits, several customer-facing regressions after upstream model changes.

Primary asks: 1) minimal prompt/regression delta when switching -> want compatibility layer and test harness, 2) clear cost model and token-level breakdowns during POC, 3) ability to lock to a model family when moving to Dedicated, 4) VPC + KMS for Dedicated deployment.
Quote from Tom Alvarez: 'We can tolerate a small quality delta if latency/cost are significantly better, but regressions in core summaries are a showstopper.'
